brief.question: Huginn-MoE: test the fixed-budget Load Once quality-transfer tradeoff, concurrently with the Ouro sibling.
brief.healthy: Native replacement verification must pass; all 20 fixed conditions are evaluated. Validation alone selects policies for ARC.
brief.noise: Hard route restrictions can greatly increase NLL; this is a scientific result, not a crash. These are full-resident quality experiments; logical copies are not latency.
brief.worth_a_flag: Nonfinite logits, native verification failure, fewer than two admissible experts, no idle GPU, or missing output. No model training occurs in this stage.
brief.from_parent: The parent established pure_shared as the strongest simple adaptation control. Its metrics have different meanings; do not compare inherited NLL improvements to this stage loss penalties.
brief.decided: No 500-step compensation or TPOT claim until the quality and memory tradeoff has been audited.
